sketchMechanisms: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil — the entire expression collapses to nothing
The 'fix' combinator finds the fixed point of a function — it defines something purely in terms of itself, an infinite self-reference that still resolves
A finally block executes even when a return statement appears in the try block — the language guarantees the last word regardless of what the main logic decided
